quests.title: The Orb Stamp
quests.summary: Weave a length of Harris Tweed on a croft loom and get it stamped with the Orb in Stornoway.

steps.text: Get a fleece from Crofter Murdo, out on the machair beside the weaver's croft.
Get crotal dye from Peigi the Dyer, outside the blackhouses at Gearrannan.
Take the fleece and dye to Seonag and weave the length on her loom.
Take the tweed to the Harris Tweed Authority in Stornoway for the Orb stamp.

quests.reward: A Harris Tweed Cap (a charm: frost moves hurt less) and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: The Scattered Chessmen
quests.summary: Five carved ivory chessmen have turned up around Harris and Lewis. Find them, then face the chess champion of Stornoway.

steps.text: Find all five chessmen: a king at Callanish, a queen at Gearrannan, a bishop at Luskentyre, a knight by the Tarbert quay and a warder in the dune at Uig.
Take them to the Curator at Museum nan Eilean, in Lews Castle.
Beat Chess Master Ailsa at her board in the museum.

quests.reward: The Ivory Warder (a charm: iron moves hit harder), the prize money and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: The Blue Men of the Minch
quests.summary: Befriend one of the Blue Men's little ones, learn how a rhyme goes, and out-rhyme the Blue Men of the Minch.

steps.text: Catch a Skaldling in the water round Harris or Stornoway and show the Old Skipper at the harbour.
Learn how a rhyme goes from the Bard at the Minch Arms.
At the end of the quay, in a gale, a fog or the dark, finish the Blue Men's three rhymes, then face them.

quests.reward: The Blue Man's Pebble (a charm: storm moves hit harder), the prize money and standing in Scotland.
